children: Veru advances sabizabulin into a planned Phase 2 trial after preclinical data show potent activity (IC50=18.2 nM) in daraxonrasib‑resistant KRAS pancreatic cancer.
New preclinical data: sabizabulin shows potent anticancer activity (IC50=18.2 nM) in daraxonrasib‑resistant KRAS pancreatic cell line.
Strategic shift: Veru will advance sabizabulin toward a Phase 2b trial for metastatic KRAS pancreatic cancer post‑daraxonrasib failure.
Program reprioritization: sabizabulin will no longer be pursued for chronic inflammation tied to atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
Clinical & IP support: prior Phase 1b/2 data in 80 patients showed tolerability and promising efficacy; global rights and patent protection extend to 2043.
Next step: Veru plans a pre‑IND meeting with FDA in Q4 2026 to clarify Phase 2b trial design and regulatory path.
